criteria.text: Opening a prompt that is a screen, or reaches a screen through calls or Dependencies, prints one URL for the whole reached app and says answers come from prompts, without claiming to test generated code.
The opened app retains every screen, navigation handler and tab in each reached app map, while unrelated app maps stay out.
Opening a prompt that reaches named HTTP routes serves those routes at localhost port 8080 without a Story; Ctrl-C closes the local listener and keeps program data.
Screen and HTTP runs keep the program's saved data, the supplied starting data or the empty fresh-start data, without replacing it with product seed values.
An app setup error explains the authored source to fix and a retry that keeps the entry, flags and product context; uncertain setup does not create a second session.
App source is captured through the ordinary safe dependency pipeline without a synthetic Story or test, a separate archive or changes to authored files.

cases.given: entry is prompts/phone/shell.prompt.md in app-map.json, with shell and tester screens and now/agents/workflows/machines handlers
cases.required_observation: one admitted hosted Screen URL for Screen-only entry; entire root map, both screens, four tab handlers and original state retained; prompt notice; no Story selection

cases.given: main.prompt.md calls shell.prompt.md; app/app-map.json contains shell and settings
cases.required_observation: select app/app-map.json and both screens through calls closure

cases.given: main has required Dependencies link reaching a screen under app/maps/phone.json; unrelated app/maps/other.json exists
cases.required_observation: phone map and all its handlers selected; other map absent

cases.given: entry reaches A; map A navigates B and B navigates A; B has stylesheet and render dependencies
cases.required_observation: both routes, full map dependency closure and stylesheet retained without infinite discovery

cases.given: entry reaches server prompt with input_schema.title HTTP GET /api/books and an admitted session model for that route
cases.required_observation: openServe uses same admitted session, default port 8080, endpoint link; GET response reaches route; unknown route causes zero dispatches; listener close retains data

cases.given: one admitted session contains app map plus named HTTP routes
cases.required_observation: one openServe listener using the admitted map and session at default port 8080; only its local Screen URL printed, no hosted or duplicate URL; same-session named routes served there; listener stays alive until Ctrl-C and retains data on close

cases.given: file main.prompt.md; flags fresh=true and data=seed.json supplied before file
cases.required_observation: programData receives entry name and both flags exactly; its returned data is passed unchanged to openProgramSession; composed seed remains overlay artifact and never substitutes for the data owner choice; C does not independently reset or choose persistence path

cases.given: composed map setup refuses an operation from authored app/maps/phone.json; program file main.prompt.md and fresh flag supplied
cases.required_observation: diagnostic names authored source and pdd --fresh main.prompt.md; retains product selection; no generated file edit instruction and no pdd try STORY

cases.given: session adapter reports unknown setup outcome after request submission
cases.required_observation: nonzero result, finite recovery keeping entry context; no second session create

cases.given: no tests or user_stories folder; required prompt graph and root app map exist
cases.required_observation: capture selects explicit entry prompts and full map with tests:[]; no scenario/Story generated, uploaded or required

cases.given: required dependency is ignored, secret-like or symlinked
cases.required_observation: existing source refusal preserved before authentication/upload; path and cause retained; no bypass reader or archive

cases.given: entry closure contains no matching app-map screen and no named HTTP title
cases.required_observation: finite unsupported-entry explanation without guessed route, app URL or created session

cases.given: HTTP title entry also has typed input_schema; separate fixture has Screen plus HTTP; ordinary typed entry has neither
cases.required_observation: appKind returns http, screen and null respectively before B typed dispatch; zero session/auth/upload effects; unsafe source keeps diagnostic

cases.given: composition seed artifact contains orders:[{id:1}]; programData chooses startingData with orders:[{id:9}] from --data input
cases.required_observation: openProgramSession receives the exact data object selected by programData with orders:[{id:9}] unchanged; overlay still includes composed artifact orders:[{id:1}]; C does not merge, replace or inject composed world into chosen starting data

cases.given: --fresh requested; programData returns fresh:true and startingData:{}; composition seed artifact contains orders:[{id:1}]
cases.required_observation: session receives same fresh data selection with empty startingData; no composed orders appear in chosen data; seed artifact stays upload-only unless session owner separately resolves no-data default binding

cases.given: programData returns persisted startingData orders:[{id:7}], fresh:false; composition seed artifact contains orders:[{id:1}]
cases.required_observation: session receives the same persisted data object and orders:[{id:7}] unchanged; C does not reset or merge product seed values

cases.given: session owner reports no persisted, explicit or fresh chosen initial data; composed seed artifact exists in overlay; no default-seed runtime adapter binding is available
cases.required_observation: preserve artifact and report required initial-world adapter binding as unresolved; do not claim product-seed world loaded merely because its file was uploaded; do not invent a competing data precedence rule
